basis: all ibm_fez snapshot files at the ref (see n_files)
machine: lead's laptop (provisional until re-run on the verification desktop)

method.residual: log10 value minus the median of the same entity's other events within +-7 days, divided by 1.4826 x MAD of the entity's residuals
method.common_mode: median residual over entities in the family's round (stamps split at gaps > 15 min), defined when >= 20 entities were re-measured
method.statistic: Pearson correlation of pooled normal scores of the residuals
method.null: circular shift of B's events within each entity, offset uniform on 10% to 90% of its event count
